title: Household profile (client-side, optional)
description: Captures household composition for personalizing the action plan. All fields optional. Stored ONLY in localStorage under `hi-hazards/household-profile-v1`. Never transmitted, never in the URL hash.

householdSize.description: Total number of people living at this address.

ages.description: Age groups present in the household. infant: <2; young_child: 2–5; school_age: 6–12; teen: 13–17; adult: 18–64; senior: 65+.

mobility.description: Highest level of mobility assistance need in the household.

vehicle.description: Vehicle access pattern. 'own': household has its own vehicle. 'shared': uses a shared/rental/family member's. 'none': no reliable vehicle access.

language.description: Preferred language code (ISO 639-1) for action-plan text. Falls back to 'en' if no translation exists for that language.

_schemaVersion.description: Profile schema version. Bumped when fields change incompatibly so loaders can migrate.
